text: make a website for my cousin's clothing boutique called Thread & Loom in Pune. it sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas. people should be able to browse products by category, filter by size and price, see a size guide, check new arrivals, and order on whatsapp. also show a lookbook section with styled outfits, the store timings and location, the return and exchange policy, and a few customer reviews. it should feel earthy and elegant and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, this is a clear picture of the shop. I need a few details that only you or your cousin know.
1. Please send these: What WhatsApp number should customers order on? Should the message fill in the product name and size for them; What is the shop's full address in Pune, and what are the opening days and hours? Please also say if there is a day it is closed.; What is the return and exchange policy? For example: how many days, whether the item must be unworn or have tags, and whether it is a refund, exchange or store credit.; Do you have the product list (names, categories, sizes, prices, photos), the lookbook photos and a few real customer reviews to share.

proposal.name: Earthy responsive styling
proposal.goal_gap: The page has no mobile layout or earthy visual identity.
